recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Dreams
recipes.subtitle: A little patience. A generous handful of parmesan.
recipes.description: Silky tomato sauce, ribbons of pasta, and basil torn by hand. The sort of supper that makes an ordinary Tuesday feel a little special.
ingredients: A small handful of fresh basil

steps.title: A pot of possibilities
steps.text: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook the pasta following its package instructions. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Wake up the garlic
steps.text: Warm the olive oil in a deep pan over a medium-low heat. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute, until fragrant but not brown.

steps.title: Slow down. Let it simmer.
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Simmer gently, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes. Reduce the heat if the sauce starts to spit.

steps.title: Bring everyone together
steps.text: Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the cream, then the drained pasta. Add a splash of reserved cooking water to loosen the sauce.

steps.title: The finishing flourish
steps.text: Remove from the heat. Fold in the parmesan and torn basil. Taste, season, and divide between two warm bowls.

recipes.title: Garden Pesto Twirls
recipes.subtitle: Flame considers extra basil a personality trait.
recipes.description: Bright basil, toasted pine nuts, and twirls of pasta. A fresh, simple lunch with a very generous green streak.

steps.title: Get the pasta going
steps.text: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water according to its package instructions. Reserve some cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Make something green
steps.text: Blend the basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice into a coarse pesto.

steps.title: Toss, taste, twirl
steps.text: Toss the warm drained pasta with the pesto off the heat. Loosen with a splash of cooking water and season to taste.

recipes.title: Slow Sunday Pancakes
recipes.subtitle: For mornings with nowhere else to be.
recipes.description: A small stack of fluffy pancakes. Bring the berries, put the kettle on, and let breakfast take its time.
ingredients: 1 tbsp melted butter, plus extra for the pan

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, and sugar together in a bowl.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: In a separate bowl whisk the egg, milk, and melted butter. Fold into the flour until just combined. A few small lumps are fine.

steps.title: Little golden circles
steps.text: Heat a lightly buttered non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Add small ladles of batter. Cook until bubbles form and the edges set, then flip and cook until golden and cooked through. Adjust the heat as needed.

steps.title: Make a morning of it
steps.text: Stack the pancakes and top with washed fresh berries. Serve straight away.
